--- original

@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+---
+depends_on:
+- 01M4B3V9XKKT81TCZFJJT4PE6E
+- 01M4B3YC73VSKE9VEP29E3CZNQ
+- 01M4B3Y4M87387J50EQCD36VB0
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '9380'
+title: Public schema and query resolvers
+---
+## What
+The read side of the public GraphQL schema. The basis is plan.md §4.1 and §3.3 rule 3.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsKanban/GraphQL/Schema.swift`: the `Node` interface (`id`, `body`, `created`, `updated`, `deleted`) and the types `Board`, `Column`, `Actor`, `Tag`, `Task`, `Comment`, `TaskConnection` (cursor paging: `edges`, `pageInfo`, `totalCount`), `BoardSummary`, `Progress`.
+- `GraphQL/QueryResolvers.swift`: resolvers read a `Graph` and the current board key from a context. Each `id` is the full URI. `Board.task(id:)`, `Board.tasks(column:, tag:, assignee:, deleted:, first:, after:)` (the `filter` argument is wired in the filter task), task order = column order, then ordinal.
+- `Query.board(id:)` for the current board only (related boards come with the cross-repo task), `Query.node(id:)`, `Query.nodes(ids:)`. A tombstone is not in lists; `node` and `nodes` return it with `deleted` set; `tasks(deleted: true)` lists only deleted tasks.
+- `Comment.author` returns a deleted author as the tombstone.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A deep query (task → dependsOn → comments → author) returns the correct nested graph from a fixture graph.
+- [ ] Paging with `first` and `after` returns each task one time.
+- [ ] A deleted task is not in `tasks`, and `node(id:)` returns it with `deleted` set.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsKanbanTests/GraphQL/QueryResolverTests.swift`: GraphQL documents against fixture graphs; compare response JSON.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter QueryResolverTests`; expect all pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
